steps.query:
float fM1
ref rF1
ref rH
ref rScan
ref rScanBase
float fX
float fY
float fZ
float fA
float fB
float fC
Begin Function { }
let fM1 := GetModIndex "FalloutNV.esm"
let rF1 := BuildRef fM1 86377
let rScan := GetFirstRef 201 2 0
while rScan != 0
  let rScanBase := rScan.GetBaseObject
  if rScanBase == rF1
    if rScan.GetSourceModIndex == 255
      if rScan.GetDisabled == 0
        let rH := rScan
      endif
    endif
  endif
  let rScan := GetNextRef
loop
if rH
  let fX := rH.GetPos X
  let fY := rH.GetPos Y
  let fZ := rH.GetPos Z
  let fA := rH.GetAngle X
  let fB := rH.GetAngle Y
  let fC := rH.GetAngle Z
endif
SetFunctionValue (($ fX) + " " + ($ fY) + " " + ($ fZ) + " " + ($ fA) + " " + ($ fB) + " " + ($ fC))
End
